# FDG9052

> DO inherit from `DependencyObject`, or one of its subtypes, when implementing dependency properties. The type provides a very efficient implementation of a property store and automatically supports WPF data binding.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.3.1 Dependency Property Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG9052
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Message: '{0}' registers the dependency property '{1}' but does not derive from DependencyObject

FDG9052 reports a static field initialized with DependencyProperty.Register or RegisterReadOnly in a class that does not derive from DependencyObject. Attached properties (RegisterAttached, section 9.3.2) are declared on any type and are not reported. Registrations outside field initializers are not seen, so coverage is partial. Changing the base class changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; there is no code fix.
